arguments.note: In transcripts/run.jsonl, usage token fields come in two spellings: prompt tokens are "prompt_tokens" if present else "input_tokens"; completion tokens are "completion_tokens" else "output_tokens". Only entries with payload.role == "assistant" count toward usage totals; non-assistant entries and missing usage contribute zero.
